# Bako 0.1.1
- fix(workflow): build universal macOS release - fix(workflow): normalize Sparkle private key secret - fix(workflow): repair release yaml syntax - fix(workflow): download Sparkle appcast tool when missing - fix: make catalog contract test locale-independent - fix(workflow): correct DIST_DIR and NOTES_PATH paths in release.yml; add validation for appcast signature - docs: enhance README with group workflow feature and updated screenshots - chore: update .gitignore to include Build directory - docs: add app screenshots to README - Add internal Sparkle release workflow - chore: update Swift tools version and development environment requirements to Swift 5.7 and Xcode 14.2 - fix(config): enable autofill for one-time code on mac - feat: refine group controls and macOS integration - Initial commit
